title: Self-Employment Tax Calculator
summary: Calculate the taxes as self-employed in USA, know how yo will pay in 1099 form
description:
Disclaimer: this is not a goverment app.
All information comes from http://irs.gov/.
You don't know how much you will pay as self-employed? Do you want to calculate how much you will pay by filling out the 1099 form?

With our app you will be able to know all this based on your self employed tax rate.

Whether you are an independent contractor, you want to know if it is profitable for you to work as a freelancer or if you prefer to combine it with a W-2 job.

Our app will help you calculate your paycheck as a self-employed 1099.

Do not pay more and learn how much is the tax for self-employed.

Download the app and don't be fooled!!
